messages:
rachel-recruiter: Quick flag — external contractor panel for C-901 today: several interviewers (contractors) say the scorecard PDF attachment didn't come through on calendar. Candidates waiting on notes.

sarah-peopleops: Did they get the link in the invite body or no attachments at all?

rachel-recruiter: No attachments. Body just has 'Interview with Redwood'. External folks use Outlook; one forwarded the invite and lost attachments.

dan-hiringops: ATS audit shows scorecard entity is a PDF asset. We recently changed attachments to be hosted links instead of inline. Looks like external calendar clients are stripping linked attachments when forwarded.

ats-bot: ats-bot: webhook_event: attachment_sync ok -> visibility=private_link

mike-intops: Short-term: I'll enable fallback to include both a hosted link and inline summary text in the invite body for PDF scorecards. Pushing patch now.

karen-ctr: Also noticed two interviewers' "trained" flag missing where they're contractors. Contract accounts have a different training namespace — maybe mapping bug.

sarah-peopleops: Good catch. Dan, can you verify training namespace mapping for contractor orgs? We want contractor training shown on roster as well.

dan-hiringops: Confirmed: contractor training events are stored under "contractor_training_v1" but roster lookup only queries "training_v2". Will add union query and backfill.

mike-intops: Patch deployed. Invite bodies updated for affected panels with https://ats.redwood/s/C-901/scorecard and a short inline bullet summary. I messaged panels to re-open invites.

rachel-recruiter: Confirmed attendees received updated body and one interviewed already. Thanks.

ats-bot: ats-bot: calendar_patch_succeeded invite-cc12 at 1892345699

sarah-peopleops: Next steps: 1) make attachment representation resilient for external clients, 2) add contractor-training namespace to roster reads, 3) add a small QA test to catch forward/strip behavior. Adding to sprint planning.

rachel-recruiter: Thanks, closing this thread — I'll follow up if any feedback missing. :thumbsup:
